member.name: T:Utilities.Api.Controllers.ProxyGatewayController
member.summary:
Data-plane forwarder (Phase 2). A tenant's client calls {METHOD} /api/proxy/gateway/{slug}/{**path} instead of the vendor; Blocks authenticates the caller with the X-Blocks-Key tenant header + a bearer valid for that tenant, rebuilds the request against the stored upstream, attaches ONLY the configured headers / query params, calls the third party server-side, relays the response, and records one per attempt.
The route is the literal api/proxy/gateway (NOT the [controller]/[action] convention); skips it so the effective path is exactly /api/proxy/gateway/... and never /api/api/.... It is at the framework level because the credential is the X-Blocks-Key header, not the standard scheme; auth is done here via .
